rotp_sex_pistols.configuration.Revolver: Settings for Sex Pistols' Revolver bullets.
rotp_sex_pistols.configuration.Sex Pisto: Sex Pistols lifecycle, targeting, and relay settings.
rotp_sex_pistols.configuration.title: RotP: Sex Pistols Configuration
rotp_sex_pistols.config.bulletDamageMult: Multiplies damage from all revolver bullet attacks, including normal shots, Piercing Shot, Splitting Shot, and Encirclement. 0 disables damage; 1 is the default; 2 doubles damage.
rotp_sex_pistols.config.IsBulletDestroye: Allows normal shots and Piercing Shot to damage and destroy blocks. Enabled by default.
rotp_sex_pistols.config.blockDamageMemor: How long partial bullet damage to a block is remembered. Default: 100 ticks (5 seconds).
rotp_sex_pistols.config.stableDamageEndD: Distance, in blocks, after which bullets enter long-range damage falloff. Default: 50 blocks.
rotp_sex_pistols.config.closeDamageDropD: Distance, in blocks, over which bullet damage falls from double at point-blank range to its stable value. Default: 5 blocks.
rotp_sex_pistols.config.minDistanceDamag: Minimum damage a bullet can deal after traveling a long distance. Default: 1 damage.
rotp_sex_pistols.config.maxRicochetCount: Maximum number of times a bullet can ricochet. Default: 2.
rotp_sex_pistols.config.sexPistolsTarget: Maximum range, in blocks, used to find targets for Sex Pistols bullet redirects. Default: 32 blocks.
rotp_sex_pistols.config.sexPistolsTransf: Maximum range, in blocks, for assisted relay kicks between Sex Pistols members. Default: 18 blocks.
rotp_sex_pistols.config.sexPistolsRevive: Time required for a defeated Sex Pistols member to revive. 20 ticks equal 1 second. Default: 1,200 ticks (60 seconds).
rotp_sex_pistols.config.isSexPistolsHung: Requires Sex Pistols members to be fed over time. Hungry members beg for food and refuse to work until fed.
rotp_sex_pistols.config.sexPistolsHunger: Minimum time before Sex Pistols become hungry. 20 ticks equal 1 second. Default: 6,000 ticks (5 minutes).
Maximum additional random delay added to the hunger timer. Total delay is the minimum plus a random value from 0 to this setting. Default: 6,000 ticks.
